name: Graphite Development Environment
description: Installs the Graphite CLI (gt) for stacked pull requests and the Graphite VS Code extension (Graphite.gti-vscode). Authenticates gt from a GRAPHITE_TOKEN environment variable on every container start — no token stored in the image. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

version.description: Version or npm dist-tag of @withgraphite/graphite-cli to install ('stable', 'latest', or a specific version like '1.8.6').
